error.title: This code could not be read
error.body: Try again in a moment, or ask the shop.

unknown.title: This code does not exist
unknown.body: The poster may be damaged. The code is printed in plain text under the QR: check it, or ask the shop.

revoked.title: This poster is no longer active
revoked.body: It has been taken out of service. Ask the shop for its queue link, or search for it on FadeUp.

inactive.title: This poster is not active yet
inactive.body: It has not been linked to a shop. Come back later, or let the shop know.

assign.title: Activate this poster
assign.body: Choose the establishment that will receive it. The QR will then lead to its queue.
assign.irreversible: An activated poster cannot be moved: only the FadeUp team can revoke it and reassign it.

refusal.already_assigned: This poster is already linked to a shop.
refusal.revoked: This poster has been taken out of service.
refusal.not_authenticated: Sign in to activate a poster.

claim.title: Is this shop yours?
claim.body: {{name}} already has a FadeUp page, and nobody has claimed it. Claiming is free and immediate.
claim.cta: See the page and claim it
